entities.summary: Walter Francis Sullivan was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the eleventh bishop of the Diocese of Richmond in Virginia from 1974 to 2003. Sullivan previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the same diocese from 1970 to 1974.
